crossRefs.note: One said to him, “Behold, your mother and your brothers stand outside, seeking to speak to you.”

parallels.note: A multitude was sitting around him, and they told him, “Behold, your mother, your brothers, and your sisters are…
Some people told him, “Your mother and your brothers stand outside, desiring to see you.”

translations.web: One said to him, “Behold, your mother and your brothers stand outside, seeking to speak to you.”
translations.bsb: Someone told Him, “Look, Your mother and brothers are standing outside, wanting to speak to You.”
translations.kjv: Then one said unto him, Behold, thy mother and thy brethren stand without, desiring to speak with thee.
translations.asv: And one said unto him, Behold, thy mother and thy brethren stand without, seeking to speak to thee.
